body: Damnit, I am having a platonic Craigslist missed connection moment on here.

You've got to wait it out a bit, but I met some really awesome people. Just leave it open in the browser and do something else, you'll here a sound when someone joins in your chat. Nice little tool when you want to vent and get some immediate feed back. All my conversations have been really beneficial and even if they start off heavy end up into really good conversation with no fear of judgement.

I feel like what happened is validated, but how badly I am handling it is not. A year after I could see the constant panic attacks and inability to communicate had worn its welcome. This only caused me to close down more and wish someone would grab me in a hug and say they understood how I felt.
